Isizathu se-physics sokuba umsinga obangelweyo uhambe ngecala 'lokuthintela' utshintsho lwe-magnetic flux ngokusebenzisa i-coil kukwanelisa ukugcinwa kwantoni?

20261119-physics-h3.goal: Apply principles of Isuntswana elinentlawulo elinobunzima m kunye nentlawulo to solve the reasoning problem.
20261119-physics-h3.material: Isuntswana elinentlawulo elinobunzima m kunye nentlawulo q, elingena ngokuthe nkqo kwimagnethi ephakathi ehambelana B, lenza intshukumo yesetyhula ngesantya v. Yeyiphi ifomula echanekileyo yomgama we-orbit r kunye nexesha T lale ntshukumo yesetyhula yesuntswana?
20261119-physics-h3.thinking.0: Isuntswana elinentlawulo elinobunzima m kunye nentlawulo
20261119-physics-h3.s.s1.prompt: Isuntswana elinentlawulo elinobunzima m kunye nentlawulo q, elingena ngokuthe nkqo kwimagnethi ephakathi ehambelana B, lenza intshukumo yesetyhula ngesantya v. Yeyiphi ifomula echanekileyo yomgama we-orbit r kunye nexesha T lale ntshukumo yesetyhula yesuntswana?
20261119-physics-h3.s.s1.explain: Ifomula yamandla e-centripetal $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Ixesha $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, kwaye kumangalisa ukuba linexesha le-cyclotron elingaxhomekekanga kumgama we-orbit okanye isantya.

20261121-physics-h3-1.material: Kwimodeli ka-Bohr ye-athomu ye-hydrogen, isimo samaza amile phakathi kobude bamaza ezinto λ ye-elektroni ehamba kwi-orbit enenani eliphambili le-quantum n kunye nomgama we-orbit r sesiphi?
20261121-physics-h3-1.thinking.0: Kwimodeli ka-Bohr ye-athomu ye-hydrogen, isimo samaza
20261121-physics-h3-1.s.s1.prompt: Kwimodeli ka-Bohr ye-athomu ye-hydrogen, isimo samaza amile phakathi kobude bamaza ezinto λ ye-elektroni ehamba kwi-orbit enenani eliphambili le-quantum n kunye nomgama we-orbit r sesiphi?
20261121-physics-h3-1.s.s1.explain: Ngokwe-hypothesis yamaza ezinto ka-de Broglie, xa ubude bomjikelezo we-orbit $2\pi r$ bulingana nenani elipheleleyo ($2\pi r = n\lambda$) lobude bamaza ezinto $\lambda$, kwenziwa amaza amile kwaye igcinwe i-orbit ye-elektroni ezinzileyo.

20261122-physics-h3-1.title: Umgama ophezulu ohambayo ngokuthe tye R
20261122-physics-h3-1.topic: Umgama ophezulu ohambayo ngokuthe tye R
20261122-physics-h3-1.goal: Apply principles of Umgama ophezulu ohambayo ngokuthe tye R to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-h3-1.material: [Ukuphuma okunzulu kwemilinganiselo emibini] Umgama ophezulu ohambayo ngokuthe tye R wesantya esikhutshwe emhlabeni nge-engile θ kumgangatho othe tye nesantya sokuqala v₀ ngu R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. Xa kungekho kumelana komoya, ngokulandelelana yeyiphi i-engile yokukhuphela θ eyenza umgama ohambayo ube phezulu, kunye nenye i-engile yokukhuphela enomgama ohambayo ofanayo nokhukhulelo lwe-30°?
20261122-physics-h3-1.thinking.0: Umgama ophezulu ohambayo ngokuthe tye R
20261122-physics-h3-1.s.s1.prompt: [Ukuphuma okunzulu kwemilinganiselo emibini] Umgama ophezulu ohambayo ngokuthe tye R wesantya esikhutshwe emhlabeni nge-engile θ kumgangatho othe tye nesantya sokuqala v₀ ngu R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. Xa kungekho kumelana komoya, ngokulandelelana yeyiphi i-engile yokukhuphela θ eyenza umgama ohambayo ube phezulu, kunye nenye i-engile yokukhuphela enomgama ohambayo ofanayo nokhukhulelo lwe-30°?
20261122-physics-h3-1.s.s1.explain: Imeko apho $\sin 2\theta$ iba phezulu ngu-$2\theta = 90^\circ \implies \theta = 45^\circ$. Kwakhona, kuba $\sin(2 \times 30^\circ) = \sin 60^\circ = \sin 120^\circ = \sin(2 \times 60^\circ)$, kwii-engile ($60^\circ$) apho isixa sibe ngu-$90^\circ$ umgama ofikelelwayo uyafana.
20261122-physics-h3-1.s.s1.hint.0: I-sin(2θ) ithatha ixabiso eliphezulu le-1 xa 2θ = 90°.
